# ConDron Chile — Servicios Profesionales de Drones
# URL: https://condron.cl
# Contact: +56 9 7986 0843 | contacto@condron.cl

## About
ConDron is a professional drone services company based in Santiago, Chile, operating nationwide. We are DGAC (Dirección General de Aeronáutica Civil) certified with AOC & RPAS licenses under DAN 151 and DAN 91 regulations. Part of MCCO Group.

## Services
We offer 7 specialized drone services with a fleet of 9 DJI enterprise drones:

1. **Topography LiDAR & Photogrammetry** — 3D point clouds, orthomosaics, DEM/DSM with RTK centimetric precision. Drones: DJI Matrice 400 + L3, Matrice 4E.
2. **Thermography & Thermal Inspection** — Infrared radiometric mapping, hot spot detection (ΔT analysis). Drone: DJI Matrice 4T (640×512 thermal sensor).
3. **NDT Thickness Measurement** — Ultrasonic non-destructive testing per API 653 for chimneys, tanks, pipes. Drone: DJI Matrice 400 + PTG6/PTG8. No scaffolding needed.
4. **Visual Structural Inspection** — Crack, corrosion, and damage detection on towers, chimneys, bridges. Drones: Mavic 4 Pro, Matrice 4T, FPV Mini.
5. **Interior & Confined Spaces** — Inspection of warehouses, tunnels, boilers, silos without human exposure. Drones: DJI Neo, FPV Mini.
6. **Cinematic Video & Photography** — 5.1K/4K Hasselblad production for corporate, real estate, marketing. Drones: Mavic 3 Pro Cine, Mavic 4 Pro.
7. **Construction Progress Monitoring** — Periodic reports, temporal comparisons, sequential orthomosaics with RTK. Drones: Matrice 4E, Mavic 4 Pro.

## Pricing (Reference in UF — Chilean currency unit)
- Basic (Video/Photo 4K): from 12 UF/day
- Professional (Photogrammetry + Inspection): from 25 UF/day
- Industrial (NDT Thickness + Thermography): from 40 UF/day
- Online calculator available at https://condron.cl/#precios

## Deliverables
- Orthomosaics (GeoTIFF, 2-3 cm/px)
- 3D Point Clouds (LAS/E57)
- DEM / DSM Digital Models
- Thermographic Reports (ΔT analysis)
- NDT Thickness Reports (API 653)
- Edited Video 4K/5.1K
- GIS / KML / Shapefile files
- PDF Inspection Reports

## Fleet (9 Drones)
- DJI Matrice 400 (LiDAR L3 + NDT PTG6/PTG8)
- DJI Matrice 4T (Thermal 640×512)
- DJI Matrice 4E (Photogrammetry 56MP)
- DJI Mavic 4 Pro (Visual)
- DJI Mavic 3 Pro Cine (Hasselblad 5.1K)
- DJI Neo (Interiors)
- DJI FPV Mini (Confined spaces)
- RTK modules for all enterprise drones

## DGAC Certifications
- AOC (Air Operator Certificate)
- RPAS Pilot Licenses (all operators)
- Civil Liability Insurance
- DAN 151 & DAN 91 compliance
- ConDron manages all DGAC permits for clients at no extra cost

## Industries Served
Mining, Energy (Solar, Wind, Electrical), Oil & Gas, Construction, Industrial Plants, Real Estate, Agriculture
